_readme: Single source of truth for the project cards and case studies. Edit this file, then run: python scripts/build.py. 'status' must be changed only after a validated milestone (see docs/MAINTAINING.md), never because of commit activity alone.

projects.name: Agent Command Center
projects.status_note: Core MVP is on main. Review, isolation and recovery work sits in draft pull requests. No real AI agent is enabled yet.
projects.summary: A local dashboard that queues coding tasks, gives each one an isolated Git worktree and holds every change for human review.
confirmed: Task queue with status tracking and logs, stored in SQLite
One branch and one Git worktree per task, so tasks never share a working copy
Local-only API bound to 127.0.0.1, with no automatic push, merge or deploy
Test suite running in CI on both Linux and Windows against a simulated agent
projects.role: Personal project. I own the product direction, architecture decisions and safety rules, and coordinate AI-assisted implementation through draft pull requests that I review before anything reaches main.
challenges: Letting an agent change code without ever giving it a path to main
Recovering cleanly when a task process fails halfway through
Keeping simulated CI results separate from real validation on a physical machine

projects.name: Collaborative Web Platform
projects.status_note: Features are built on integration branches that are still under review. Not released.
projects.summary: A mobile-first community web app with posts, a paginated feed and shared boards where members propose clues and the author accepts them.
confirmed: Email sign-up, sign-in and password reset with Supabase Auth
Posts, likes and comments in a paginated feed
Database schema and row-level security policies managed as SQL migrations
End-to-end and schema contract tests with Playwright
projects.role: Team project. I contribute to authentication, the feed, data persistence and responsive interfaces, and run the branch and pull request workflow for integration rounds.
challenges: Writing row-level security rules so users can only change their own content
Keeping the feed stable while paginating and updating counts
Testing auth flows without depending on a live backend

projects.name: Gym Management System
projects.status_note: Being audited and fixed before it is featured as a finished project.
projects.summary: A command-line app for managing gym members: registration, search, plan changes and reports with charts.
confirmed: Create, list, search, edit and delete member records
Reports for active and inactive members, members per plan and by gender, drawn with Matplotlib
Schema update routine that adds a new column without dropping existing data
projects.role: Personal project. I wrote most of the code.
challenges: Changing the database schema on an existing file without losing records
Separating input handling, database access and reports into modules

projects.name: VAULT//SHIFT
projects.status_note: Playable in Roblox Studio. Multiplayer, mobile and controller testing are still pending. Not published.
projects.summary: A multiplayer sci-fi arena game for Roblox where two teams fight over energy cores while reshaping the map.
confirmed: Melee and ranged combat resolved on the server, with hit validation and rate limiting
Combat HUD, health bars and hit effects on the client
Arena map kept under version control as code through Rojo
Blender-made models rendering in single-player test sessions
projects.role: Personal project. I lead game design, art direction and sprint planning, and direct AI-assisted implementation that I play-test and review.
challenges: Never trusting the client: range, angle and invalid input are checked on the server
Keeping edits made inside Roblox Studio in sync with the repository
